51e8ea87fa3f96e8.en: The word “Moscow” in any authority's name means it has competence over the city of Moscow.
51e8ea87fa3f96e8.zh: 任何机关名称中出现“莫斯科”，都意味着其有权管辖莫斯科市。

2f07e55c6d6aea7b.en: An information telephone number automatically replaces written referral of an appeal.
2f07e55c6d6aea7b.zh: 咨询电话号码可以自动替代书面诉求转交。

477e3574e19f2948.en: Find the basis for forwarding an appeal to the competent authority.
477e3574e19f2948.zh: 查找按职权转交诉求的依据。

f235c7769389bd4e.en: I gave the enterprise's Moscow address in my letter. They suggested sending it to the directorate for Moscow Region. Is that definitely the right authority? I do not want the letter sent round in circles again.
f235c7769389bd4e.zh: 我在信中注明了企业的莫斯科地址。他们建议转给负责莫斯科州的管理局。这肯定是正确的机关吗？我不希望信件又被来回转送。

7e6c021bb620f7ed.en: In the city of Moscow. The address matches the official reference note.
7e6c021bb620f7ed.zh: 在莫斯科市。地址与公务说明一致。

69377ff72d91c445.en: The location is the city of Moscow.

945ee32ffb1a1851.en: Is the site in the city of Moscow or in Moscow Region?
945ee32ffb1a1851.zh: 该对象位于莫斯科市还是莫斯科州？

a5f102381659e581.en: Consideration of my written appeal. I want to check the contact details so I can choose the correct route.
a5f102381659e581.zh: 我要求审查书面诉求。我想核实联系方式，以选择正确转交路径。

84de6c1d5f541f70.en: An enquiry call does not replace formal referral.
84de6c1d5f541f70.zh: 电话咨询不能代替正式转交。

03a383f9abb7aedb.en: Are you asking for information by telephone or consideration of your letter?
03a383f9abb7aedb.zh: 您是要求电话咨询，还是审查来信？

3d1b2a94a8cc3342.en: The training extract explicitly states: federal state environmental supervision.
3d1b2a94a8cc3342.zh: 教学摘录明确写明：联邦国家环境监督。

c9db0d3441f7accb.en: The supporting document establishes the federal level.
c9db0d3441f7accb.zh: 证明文件已明确为联邦级。

1be1ec1381081b70.en: Is there information about the level of supervision?
1be1ec1381081b70.zh: 是否有关于监督层级的信息？

cef951ad48327dda.en: A fictional training department registered the appeal. The attached official note states that the site is in the city of Moscow and subject to federal environmental supervision. You prepare referral to the competent authority and a notification. You do not independently order an inspection or establish guilt.
cef951ad48327dda.zh: 虚构的教学部门已登记诉求。所附公务说明表明，该对象位于莫斯科市，属于联邦环境监督范围。您应准备转交有权机关的文件和通知，不得自行决定检查或认定责任。

b5d6a4ec280f9aa4.en: Reception office of a Moscow public authority
b5d6a4ec280f9aa4.zh: 莫斯科权力机关接待室

c56ba2d460c86a6f.en: Prepare referral to Rosprirodnadzor's directorate for the city of Moscow and Kaluga Region.
c56ba2d460c86a6f.zh: 准备转交俄罗斯联邦自然资源利用监督局负责莫斯科市和卡卢加州的管理局。

74dc0a27750b246a.en: Send it to the Scientific and Technical Council because its telephone number appears on the official website.
74dc0a27750b246a.zh: 因科学技术委员会的电话号码刊登在官方网站上，就将材料发给该委员会。

873621171ae2ed5f.en: Send it to the directorate for Moscow and Smolensk Regions solely because the name looks similar.
873621171ae2ed5f.zh: 仅因名称相似，就发给负责莫斯科州和斯摩棱斯克州的管理局。

9df9e16e89986dfc.zh: 莫斯科市不是莫斯科州

7f8a2c2369410585.en: An official source is necessary for trusting the contact details, but does not prove that a particular contact is applicable.
7f8a2c2369410585.zh: 官方来源是信任联系方式的必要条件，但不能证明某个具体联系方式适用于本案。

85e4584be3cb46ba.en: Send the complaint to any employee of the agency without distinguishing their powers.
85e4584be3cb46ba.zh: 不区分职权，将投诉交给该部门的任意工作人员。

a702a99661dd7e61.en: Check the unit's functions and territorial boundaries, not just its official domain.
a702a99661dd7e61.zh: 核查部门职能和辖区范围，而不只是官方网站域名。

b36f93ccb46e2c36.en: Assistant: “The Scientific and Technical Council and the territorial directorate are on the same website, so they are interchangeable recipients.”
b36f93ccb46e2c36.zh: 助手：“科学技术委员会和地方管理局在同一个网站上，因此收件对象可以互相替代。”

05201f444d190fb2.en: Compare the date of the ruling with the outgoing dispatch status.
05201f444d190fb2.zh: 对照决定作出日期与发文状态。

28a8633221e5e3bc.en: Identify the recipients of the copy under the applicable rule.
28a8633221e5e3bc.zh: 依据适用规定确定副本接收人。

8f25990cf454c76e.en: Prepare the handoff for sending the copy, without re-signing judicial acts.
8f25990cf454c76e.zh: 准备将副本交付发送，不重新签署司法文书。

f063f63daf08b2bc.en: Protect the participants' data and use their proper addresses.
f063f63daf08b2bc.zh: 保护参与人的数据，并使用其正确地址。

eceba9398f5ac98d.en: Check registered confirmation that P-73 specifically was sent.
eceba9398f5ac98d.zh: 核实登记证明是否明确对应 P-73 的发送。

af159cc860000416.en: Start a new ten-day period from the citizen's call.
af159cc860000416.zh: 从公民来电时重新计算十日期限。

d6473b0214f354af.en: Send the materials to all unrelated creditors of the debtor.
d6473b0214f354af.zh: 将材料发送给债务人的所有无关债权人。

8530eb6c84718381.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. A ruling on a party's specific motion was already issued on {{decided}}. The task concerns sending a copy under Part 7 of Article 64.1, not reconsideration or receipt of money. The fictional records establish that it was not sent; there are no special circumstances altering this procedure.
8530eb6c84718381.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。针对一方具体申请的决定已于 {{decided}} 作出。任务涉及按第 64.1 条第 7 款发送副本，而非重新审理或收到款项。虚构材料证实尚未发送，且不存在改变该程序的特殊情形。

78db2e6ed0af35cf.en: Part 7 of Article 64.1 and Articles 15–16 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ. First identify the starting event.
78db2e6ed0af35cf.zh: 第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 64.1 条第 7 款及第 15–16 条。先确定起算事件。

559b80f7111dfd6d.en: Part 7 of Article 64.1 and Articles 15–16 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ
559b80f7111dfd6d.zh: 第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 64.1 条第 7 款及第 15–16 条

d71368126f9d13f2.en: Deadline for sending a copy of the issued ruling
d71368126f9d13f2.zh: 发送已作出决定副本的截止日期

577ae919ed875d1e.en: The motion has already been resolved, so a different control date and action are needed. The decision-making period cannot be reused as a new period for sending it.
577ae919ed875d1e.zh: 该申请已处理完毕，因此需要不同的监督日期和行动。不能将作出决定的期限重新用作发送期限。

4c7ff403bf11f7ba.en: An employee suggested counting a new ten-day period from Ilya's call. No legal basis was cited.
4c7ff403bf11f7ba.zh: 一名工作人员建议从伊利亚来电时重新计算十日期限，但未说明法律依据。

59e2c0cec5166106.en: An authorised bailiff issued a ruling on motion Kh-73 on {{decided}}. The enforcement proceedings and participants are identified. No new motion was filed.
59e2c0cec5166106.zh: 有权执行员于 {{decided}} 就 Kh-73 申请作出决定。执行案件和参与人已明确，没有提交新的申请。

56505397e1c97b15.en: Entry P-73 is marked “signed, not sent”. There is no dispatch entry for the prescribed recipients. The delivery entry for another document, P-72, does not relate to this ruling.
56505397e1c97b15.zh: P-73 记录标记为“已签署，未发送”。对规定接收人没有发送记录。另一份文件 P-72 的送达记录不属于本决定。

ea58b50c0defa694.en: Event: {{observed}}. The letter was sent on {{sent}}, received by the specified reception office or unit on {{received}}, and registered on {{registered}}. The ruling was issued on {{decided}}.
ea58b50c0defa694.zh: 事件：{{observed}}。信件于 {{sent}} 发出，指定接待室或部门于 {{received}} 收到，于 {{registered}} 登记。决定于 {{decided}} 作出。

163769bbdac867e3.en: The decision has already been made; the separate action of sending its copy is being checked. The motion has already been resolved, so a different control date and action are needed. The decision-making period cannot be reused as a new period for sending it.
163769bbdac867e3.zh: 决定已经作出；现在核查的是另行发送副本的行为。该申请已处理完毕，因此需要不同的监督日期和行动。不能将作出决定的期限重新用作发送期限。

593e72106bfe5499.en: The decision has already been made; the separate action of sending its copy is being checked.
593e72106bfe5499.zh: 决定已经作出；现在核查的是另行发送副本的行为。

a87e213fe01bd945.en: Every call restarts the period for considering the original motion.
a87e213fe01bd945.zh: 每次来电都会重新开始原申请的审查期限。

95707554704cffba.en: Signing the ruling automatically confirms dispatch to all recipients.
95707554704cffba.zh: 签署决定就自动证明已向所有接收人发送。

7409c8151f9f70cc.en: The registry sent a copy only to the applicant, although the prescribed recipients also include other identified participants.
7409c8151f9f70cc.zh: 文书办公室仅向申请人发送了副本，但规定接收人还包括其他已明确的参与人。

bdcf68d9cff079f2.en: Check that all prescribed recipients were sent the copy, without disclosing data to outsiders.
bdcf68d9cff079f2.zh: 核实是否向全部规定接收人发送副本，不向无关人员泄露数据。

5f67568066d0ede0.en: Close follow-up after the first dispatch regardless of the recipients.
5f67568066d0ede0.zh: 不管接收人是谁，第一次发送后就结束监督。

99f9f11f6f3ed7bd.en: Publish the ruling openly instead of sending it properly.
99f9f11f6f3ed7bd.zh: 公开发布决定，而不按规定发送。

67d2bd76701c88f7.en: Reconsider the same motion for ten days instead of sending the copy.
67d2bd76701c88f7.zh: 再用十天审理同一申请，而不发送副本。

264fb331ab9d6be4.en: Treat signing as proof of postal delivery.
264fb331ab9d6be4.zh: 将签署视为邮政送达的证明。

fc9cf8e5b711e180.en: Find the legal basis for this action: distinguish issuing the ruling from sending its copy no later than the next day.
fc9cf8e5b711e180.zh: 查找下列措施的法律依据：区分作出决定与最迟次日发送其副本。

7b2ba9ada9c22a30.en: They told me the motion has already been considered. The log contains a ruling, but no copy was sent to anyone. They suggest waiting another ten days.
7b2ba9ada9c22a30.zh: 他们告诉我申请已经审理。日志里有决定，但没有向任何人发送副本。他们建议再等十天。

97154df39c317ed3.en: Monitor dispatch of a copy of the issued ruling under Part 7 of Article 64.1.
97154df39c317ed3.zh: 按第 64.1 条第 7 款监督已作出决定副本的发送。

31c51b6cbe6cdc24.zh: 决定本身是否已经存在？

5ad72e4a72aa0aba.en: The copy has not been sent.

17d06e0595c36858.zh: 已签署，但没有发送记录。

dc93555194e4eda7.en: What does the outgoing log confirm?

86c8d99d4c32ad68.en: For now, I am specifically asking for it to be sent.
86c8d99d4c32ad68.zh: 目前我只是要求落实发送。

1c7b5cdb63832989.en: Are you challenging the content of the ruling?
1c7b5cdb63832989.zh: 您是在对决定内容提出异议吗？

7de5f3b0a4935919.en: Outgoing-document control specialist at an FSSP unit
7de5f3b0a4935919.zh: 俄罗斯联邦司法执行局部门发文监督专员

68d6fce6a9c30344.en: The FSSP unit responsible for sending the authorised bailiff's ruling.
68d6fce6a9c30344.zh: 负责发送有权执行员决定的俄罗斯联邦司法执行局部门。

601d8ff12e4ee019.en: Distinguish issuing the ruling from sending its copy no later than the next day.
601d8ff12e4ee019.zh: 区分作出决定与最迟次日发送其副本。

15b8a2fd7cc74a1e.zh: 决定已作出，副本未发送

9cd789d6a3e1fa50.en: Distinguish issuing the ruling from sending its copy no later than the next day. The motion has already been resolved, so a different control date and action are needed. The decision-making period cannot be reused as a new period for sending it.
9cd789d6a3e1fa50.zh: 区分作出决定与最迟次日发送其副本。该申请已处理完毕，因此需要不同的监督日期和行动。不能将作出决定的期限重新用作发送期限。

641e832779f6ba51.en: A signature on the ruling is enough to conclude that its copy has already been sent.
641e832779f6ba51.zh: 决定上有签名，就足以认定副本已发送。

4a6bb8b5c66b6d85.en: Check the applicant's status, signature and specific request.
4a6bb8b5c66b6d85.zh: 核实申请人身份地位、签名及具体请求。

9b48fbded92590f2.en: Establish receipt by the authorised official.
9b48fbded92590f2.zh: 查明有权官员何时收到材料。

888c7288f94d2686.en: Prepare consideration of the motion with a formal ruling on the outcome.
888c7288f94d2686.zh: 准备审查申请，并以正式决定记录结果。

c9c65bcacc1a70c9.en: Do not guarantee recovery or a measure without assessing its grounds.
c9c65bcacc1a70c9.zh: 未评估依据，不得保证追回款项或采取某项措施。

7075b0fc2d8b00ac.en: Separately monitor dispatch of the ruling's copy.
7075b0fc2d8b00ac.zh: 另行监督决定副本的发送。

e456707431ef08e0.en: Postpone the special procedure to the general thirty-day deadline.
e456707431ef08e0.zh: 将特别程序推迟至一般三十日期限。

287ff15c810c180c.en: Immediately debit funds on behalf of the reception office.
287ff15c810c180c.zh: 以接待室名义立即扣划资金。

58e05f40d708e028.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. Maria is the enforcement creditor. Her signed motion contains a specific request for an enforcement action in proceedings IP-51. It reached the authorised bailiff after receipt by the unit. No special shortened deadline or suspension circumstances apply to this motion. The bailiff assesses the necessity and legality of the measure itself; the reception office does not promise its mandatory use.
58e05f40d708e028.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。玛丽亚是申请执行人。她签署的申请要求在 IP-51 执行案件中采取一项具体执行行动。该申请先由部门收到，之后才交给有权执行员。本申请不存在特别缩短期限或中止情形。措施本身的必要性和合法性由执行员评估；接待室不得承诺一定采取该措施。

666dbce264e84b1f.en: Part 5 of Article 64.1 and Article 15 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ. First identify the starting event.
666dbce264e84b1f.zh: 第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 64.1 条第 5 款及第 15 条。先确定起算事件。

81a49de43632f0d4.en: Part 5 of Article 64.1 and Article 15 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ
81a49de43632f0d4.zh: 第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 64.1 条第 5 款及第 15 条

e1c4fe7cdb7023f4.en: Deadline for the authorised bailiff to consider the motion
e1c4fe7cdb7023f4.zh: 有权执行员审查申请的截止日期

3df14f9377bb1e55.en: The base case concerned a complaint through the chain of command. Here there is a party's specific motion: the procedure, outcome and event starting the deadline change.
3df14f9377bb1e55.zh: 基础案例涉及向上级提出的投诉。此处是一方提交的具体申请，因此程序、处理结果和期限起算事件均发生变化。

106005178bd70da7.en: In the absence of a special deadline, an authorised official considers a specific motion requesting enforcement actions within ten days of receiving it. The outcome is formalised as a ruling. A copy is sent to the prescribed participants no later than the day after it is issued. An ordinary information request that does not seek a specific enforcement action follows a different procedure. Days are calculated under Article 15 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ.
106005178bd70da7.zh: 没有特别期限时，有权官员应在收到具体执行行动申请之日起十日内审查。处理结果以决定形式作出，副本最迟应于作出决定的次日发送给规定参与人。不请求具体执行行动的一般信息查询适用另一程序。日期计算应遵守第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 15 条。

c8e88caef804a879.en: The thirty-day letter did not assess the substance of Kh-51. No ruling granting or refusing it has yet been issued.
c8e88caef804a879.zh: 关于三十日期限的信件未评估 Kh-51 的实质内容。尚未作出准许或驳回申请的决定。

3114e2213906eff0.en: The motion identifies proceedings IP-51, a specific account known to the enforcement creditor, and a request to verify information for an enforcement action. Maria signed the motion; it is not a general enquiry about progress.
3114e2213906eff0.zh: 申请列明了 IP-51 执行案件、申请执行人所知的具体账户，以及为采取执行行动核查信息的请求。玛丽亚已签署该申请；这不是一般的工作进度查询。

4969016991ec32c5.en: Kh-51 reached the unit on {{received}}, was registered on {{registered}}, and was handed to the authorised bailiff on {{officialReceived}}. The log confirms the handoff.
4969016991ec32c5.zh: 部门于 {{received}} 收到 Kh-51，于 {{registered}} 登记，并于 {{officialReceived}} 交给有权执行员。日志证实了该转交。

a6659b052a7a9071.en: Event: {{observed}}. The letter was sent on {{sent}}, received by the specified reception office or unit on {{received}}, and registered on {{registered}}. The authorised bailiff received the motion on {{officialReceived}}.
a6659b052a7a9071.zh: 事件：{{observed}}。信件于 {{sent}} 发出，指定接待室或部门于 {{received}} 收到，于 {{registered}} 登记。有权执行员于 {{officialReceived}} 收到申请。

a9aaa171b5e86aac.en: This is a specific motion for an enforcement action; its deadline is linked to receipt by the authorised bailiff. The base case concerned a complaint through the chain of command. Here there is a party's specific motion: the procedure, outcome and event starting the deadline change.
a9aaa171b5e86aac.zh: 这是一项具体执行行动申请，其期限与有权执行员收到申请的时间相关。基础案例涉及向上级提出的投诉。此处是一方提交的具体申请，因此程序、处理结果和期限起算事件均发生变化。

a846106a3afc224c.en: This is a specific motion for an enforcement action; its deadline is linked to receipt by the authorised bailiff.
a846106a3afc224c.zh: 这是一项具体执行行动申请，其期限与有权执行员收到申请的时间相关。

ab6ead2c06d4e626.en: Every letter from an enforcement creditor is considered only as a general appeal within thirty days.
ab6ead2c06d4e626.zh: 申请执行人的任何来信都只能作为一般诉求在三十日内处理。

65752e17c0d78355.en: Forwarding the motion automatically means it has been granted.
65752e17c0d78355.zh: 转交申请就自动意味着申请获准。

ae2921e3f678442c.en: A ruling on another creditor's Kh-52 arrived; the handler treats it as confirmation that Kh-51 was considered.
ae2921e3f678442c.zh: 收到针对另一申请执行人的 Kh-52 的决定；经办人将其视为已审查 Kh-51 的证明。

d7baf367cbcb6645.en: Check the applicant and motion number; a ruling on Kh-52 does not confirm resolution of Kh-51.
d7baf367cbcb6645.zh: 核对申请人和申请编号；针对 Kh-52 的决定不能证明 Kh-51 已处理。

85254bef18a56469.en: Close follow-up based on any ruling by the same bailiff.
85254bef18a56469.zh: 凭同一执行员作出的任意决定就结束监督。

112d4f1e6281196c.en: Declare the motion granted without a relevant decision.
112d4f1e6281196c.zh: 没有相关决定，就宣布申请获准。

a1744af91a0c67d2.en: Replace a ruling with a notification in general correspondence.
a1744af91a0c67d2.zh: 以一般通信通知代替正式决定。

8a2a249d06694227.en: Treat ten days as a deadline guaranteeing recovery of the entire amount.
8a2a249d06694227.zh: 将十日视为保证追回全部款项的期限。

420bedd35471c99c.en: Find the legal basis for this action: apply the specific-motion procedure under Article 64.1 without promising that the motion will be granted.
420bedd35471c99c.zh: 查找下列措施的法律依据：适用第 64.1 条的具体申请程序，不承诺申请必定获准。

7c3fbf5f536b4938.en: I asked the bailiff to check a specific debtor's account in my proceedings. They sent me the usual thirty-day notification. Is that really just a request for a progress update?
7c3fbf5f536b4938.zh: 我请求执行员核查我案件中债务人的一个具体账户。他们却发来普通的三十日通知。这难道只是请求告知进展吗？

fff2b1b7d39e8a85.en: Consideration of a specific motion by a party to enforcement proceedings.
fff2b1b7d39e8a85.zh: 审查执行程序一方提交的具体申请。

05781ff5faff5b3d.en: I am the enforcement creditor in IP-51.
05781ff5faff5b3d.zh: 我是 IP-51 的申请执行人。

2199f2282c2c98b1.en: What is your status in the proceedings?
2199f2282c2c98b1.zh: 您在执行程序中的身份是什么？

abd7c4a6950fa8e7.en: Verify specific information for an enforcement action.
abd7c4a6950fa8e7.zh: 为采取执行行动核查具体信息。

a3c64fdd8b3e786d.en: According to the log, the authorised bailiff received it on {{officialReceived}}.
a3c64fdd8b3e786d.zh: 根据日志，有权执行员于 {{officialReceived}} 收到。

cdd92622ed472de7.en: Who received the motion, and when?

83dc488aa442defa.en: No, only a notification using standard wording.
83dc488aa442defa.zh: 没有，只有使用标准措辞的通知。

f6b7923df913ca33.en: Is there a ruling on the outcome?
f6b7923df913ca33.zh: 是否有处理结果的正式决定？

c4450a4594482e47.en: Incoming-document support specialist at an FSSP unit
c4450a4594482e47.zh: 俄罗斯联邦司法执行局部门收文处理专员

19bd591228f4d5e0.en: The authorised FSSP official who received the motion in IP-51.
19bd591228f4d5e0.zh: 收到 IP-51 申请的俄罗斯联邦司法执行局有权官员。

4281d3347c0d277a.en: Apply the specific-motion procedure under Article 64.1 without promising that the motion will be granted.
4281d3347c0d277a.zh: 适用第 64.1 条的具体申请程序，不承诺申请必定获准。

ed8c399e84d29582.en: A motion is not an information enquiry

ce876881cbc5a477.en: Apply the specific-motion procedure under Article 64.1 without promising that the motion will be granted. The base case concerned a complaint through the chain of command. Here there is a party's specific motion: the procedure, outcome and event starting the deadline change.
ce876881cbc5a477.zh: 适用第 64.1 条的具体申请程序，不承诺申请必定获准。基础案例涉及向上级提出的投诉。此处是一方提交的具体申请，因此程序、处理结果和期限起算事件均发生变化。

438f0266b897a535.en: The specificity of the enforcement action matters when distinguishing a motion from a general enquiry.
438f0266b897a535.zh: 区分申请与一般查询时，执行行动是否具体具有重要意义。

3cb8815359eb16f7.en: Establish the type of complaint and its admissibility under the conditions
3cb8815359eb16f7.zh: 确定投诉类型及其按题设条件是否可受理

bcd8e6dd1540a76d.en: Verify receipt by the authorised official and whether a court has accepted an application
bcd8e6dd1540a76d.zh: 核实有权官员收件，以及法院是否已受理申请

613c84c62e76a672.en: Calculate the deadline excluding non-working days and arrange follow-up
613c84c62e76a672.zh: 排除非工作日计算期限，并安排监督

b2f899965c61565b.en: Explain the difference between a complaint decision and receiving recovered funds
b2f899965c61565b.zh: 说明投诉处理决定与收到执行款项的区别

14a07a718c755a52.zh: 单独跟踪新的程序情形

58c3952762c91003.en: Guarantee recovery of the debt by the complaint deadline
58c3952762c91003.zh: 保证在投诉处理期限届满前追回债务

896006719fed6bb8.en: Suspend the complaint merely because of an intention to go to court
896006719fed6bb8.zh: 仅因有意向法院起诉就中止投诉审查

9f323fa05c7198bc.en: Not a recovery deadline and not a response deadline for every letter to the FSSP.
9f323fa05c7198bc.zh: 这不是执行款项追回期限，也不是所有寄往联邦司法执行局的信件答复期限。

21349adeed25dc8b.en: Federal Law No. 229-FZ, Articles 15, 16 and 126. There is no suspension in the initial episode; it arises only in the continuation.
21349adeed25dc8b.zh: 第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 15、16 和 126 条。初始情节不存在中止，中止仅在后续情节中出现。

170ab0554c96711a.en: Last day for considering a complaint through the chain of command
170ab0554c96711a.zh: 向上级提出的投诉审查截止日

6959d5c603e37380.en: A complaint through the chain of command reached the authorised official on {{competent}}. In the initial episode it is admissible and has not been suspended.
6959d5c603e37380.zh: 向上级提出的投诉于 {{competent}} 到达有权官员。在初始情节中，该投诉可受理且未中止。

b55326bbf8e202de.en: At the start of the case there is only an intention to go to court. No application has yet been accepted by a court.
b55326bbf8e202de.zh: 案件开始时，仅存在向法院起诉的意向。法院尚未受理任何申请。

898fb5a653a84de9.en: The special complaint deadline must be applied using the calculation rules in the law on enforcement proceedings.
898fb5a653a84de9.zh: 应适用投诉特别期限，并依照执行程序法的规则计算。

9037cbdf55b49c74.en: Every complaint against a bailiff is always considered only within 30 calendar days.
9037cbdf55b49c74.zh: 对执行员的任何投诉始终都只能在 30 个日历日内审查。

e3b22519d8090941.en: The intention to sue itself suspends consideration.
e3b22519d8090941.zh: 打算起诉本身就会中止审查。

98702a375001c071.en: A court order arrived accepting an application challenging the same failure to act.
98702a375001c071.zh: 收到法院裁定，受理对同一不作为提出异议的申请。

9705c012c3666d28.en: Apply the suspension of complaint consideration provided by Article 126; do not confuse it with termination of the proceedings.
9705c012c3666d28.zh: 考虑第 126 条规定的投诉审查中止，不要将其与终止执行程序混淆。

bc5031a7be5e7196.en: Continue without taking the court order into account.
bc5031a7be5e7196.zh: 不考虑法院裁定，继续审查。

1fe3ed623e9993d5.en: Articles 15 and 126 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ provide a ten-day period, excluding non-working days, for an authorised official to consider an admissible complaint. This is not a debt-recovery deadline. Suspension of consideration is linked to a court accepting the relevant application, not to the applicant's intention to go to court.
1fe3ed623e9993d5.zh: 第 229-FZ 号联邦法律第 15 和 126 条规定，有权官员应在十日内审查可受理投诉，计算时排除非工作日。这不是债务追回期限。中止审查取决于法院受理相关申请，而不是申请人打算起诉。

c53b443f72818d26.en: Find the special deadline for considering a complaint through the chain of command.
c53b443f72818d26.zh: 查找向上级提出的投诉的特别审查期限。

7f7572626eddcf4a.en: I am complaining about a bailiff's failure to act. Reception told me to wait the standard thirty days, but I saw ten in the law. I am also considering going to court—would that change things?
7f7572626eddcf4a.zh: 我投诉执行员不作为。接待室让我按标准等三十天，但我在法律中看到的是十天。我也在考虑向法院起诉，这会改变情况吗？

25a1b6c75a0d977a.en: Complaint through the chain of command under Federal Law No. 229-FZ
25a1b6c75a0d977a.zh: 依据第 229-FZ 号联邦法律向上级提出的投诉

7701cfa4e17e50d0.en: Only the general procedure under No. 59-FZ
7701cfa4e17e50d0.zh: 仅适用第 59-FZ 号法律的一般程序

90e3f184f252bb4a.en: A complaint about inaction in specific enforcement proceedings, filed through the chain of command.
90e3f184f252bb4a.zh: 针对具体执行案件中的不作为，向上级提出的投诉。

8469552fd2f380f8.en: Receipt is confirmed on {{competent}}; technical registration took place later.
8469552fd2f380f8.zh: 确认于 {{competent}} 收到，技术登记在之后完成。

d45117dc3844cc79.en: The law directly specifies the starting event.
d45117dc3844cc79.zh: 法律已直接规定起算事件。

8292b3fede788d15.en: When did the authorised supervisor receive it?

f6ae1b6eba780b06.en: In the initial episode, no application has been accepted by a court.
f6ae1b6eba780b06.zh: 在初始情节中，法院尚未受理申请。

4a50c2744d27968a.en: No specified ground for suspension exists.
4a50c2744d27968a.zh: 不存在题设所指的中止依据。

828fe4f374c28940.en: Are there court proceedings concerning this challenge?
828fe4f374c28940.zh: 是否已就该异议启动法院程序？

44f13aa63aa3406c.en: Examine the failure to act; this deadline does not guarantee actual receipt of the debt.
44f13aa63aa3406c.zh: 审查不作为；该期限不保证实际收到债务款项。

a679204645dd6eab.en: The consideration deadline and the recovery outcome are different matters.
a679204645dd6eab.zh: 审查期限与执行追回结果是不同事项。
